## Worker Lead Dashboard v1

Read-only worker view served via GET webhook through the existing Caddy -> n8n delivery path. Fixed SELECT (no request input reaches SQL), self-contained HTML with suburb/area search, status filter, and hot/warm/cold qualification band filter (hot >= 80, warm >= 55, cold otherwise). No credentials or write actions exposed to the browser. Unguessable path segment is the current access control; replace with proper auth when the worker portal matures.
